verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vanta tracks 'monitored computers' alongside personnel in audit scope. It also lists Mobile Device Managers (MDM) as a category for automated evidence collection and testing, though only through the Vanta API. Nothing documents per-employee workstation checks or a first-party device agent or native MDM integration. missing for 10: documented disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks, per-employee workstation compliance view, explicit agent or native MDM integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: review the resources, personnel, and monitored computers in scope for each engagement
The Vanta API lets you automate evidence collection and testing across a wide range of system categories, including security awareness training, background checks, Mobile Device Managers (MDM)
